text: This resolves both gate errors and the timer warning: the previous `setInterval`/`clearInterval` calls (undeclared globals, and non-deterministic anyway) are gone entirely. The dashboard now uses a fixed, deterministic seed time and two buttons (**+1 сек** / **+1 мин**) that step the clock forward via plain Reatom actions — no wall clock, no timers, same layout (time, date, day-progress gauge, world-clock table) and all element ids preserved.
